technicalQuestions.text: Aapne kaun kaun se wax use kiye hain — jaise Rica, honey, peel-off? Aur facial mein kaun se kits — O3+, Casmara, Lotus, VLCC ya koi aur?
technicalQuestions.probe: Kaunsa wax kis body part pe use karti thi?

technicalQuestions.text: Rica jaise lipo wax aur normal honey wax mein kya farak hota hai? Aap kaunsa kab use karti hain?
technicalQuestions.probe: Wax ke baad bachi chipchipahat kaise saaf karti hain?

technicalQuestions.text: Peel-off wax kahan use karte hain, aur kyun?
Waxing se pehle aur baad mein skin pe kya lagati hain?
technicalQuestions.probe: Customer ko baad mein kya dhyan rakhne ko kehti hain?

technicalQuestions.text: Ek normal facial ke steps bataiye — shuru se end tak.
Oily aur pimple wali skin ke liye facial mein aap kya dhyan rakhti hain?
Pedicure ke baad tools aur baaki saamaan ka kya karti hain?

customerScenarios.text: Facial mask ke time acne wali customer kehti hai jalan ho rahi hai. Aap kya karengi?
Customer ne thick eyebrows bola tha, par ek eyebrow zyada patli ho gayi. Customer gussa hai. Kya karengi?
customerScenarios.probe: Agli baar ye na ho, uske liye kya karengi?

customerScenarios.text: Honey wax ke time customer baar baar bol rahi hai wax bahut garam hai. Kya karengi?
Service ke time customer ka bachcha baar baar beech mein aa raha hai. Kya karengi?
Cleanup ke baad customer chhota back massage maangti hai jo service mein nahi hai. Kya karengi?
Customer app ke bahar discount maang rahi hai. Kya karengi?
Customer ek service add karna chahti hai jo book nahi ki. Kya karengi?
Traffic ki wajah se aap job pe 20 minute late ho rahi hain. Kya karengi?

closingQuestions.text: Kya aapko UC ke baare mein kuch poochna hai?
Dhanyavaad! Hamari team aapko agla step batayegi.
closingQuestions.rule: Bot never states pass or fail.

openIssues: Random selection must use a defined reproducible policy before production.
